arxiv-2106-00533.title: Efficient verification and fidelity estimation of discrete bipartite squeezed states
arxiv-2106-00533.creator: Russell P Rundle
arxiv-2106-00533.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Russell P Rundle. To gain an advantage, quantum technologies utilize phenomena particular to quantum mechanics. Two such phenomena are squeezing and entanglement. Having generated states that exhibit these features, verification of their generation with local measurements can be a difficult process. Here we consider the states that are generated using the two-qudit single-axis squeezing Hamiltonian, that not only produces entangled two-qudit squeezed states but also results in various forms of interesting entangled states.

arxiv-2406-05113.title: LlavaGuard : An Open VLM-based Framework for Safeguarding Vision Datasets and Models
arxiv-2406-05113.creator: Lukas Helff, Felix Friedrich, Manuel Brack, Kristian Kersting, Patrick Schramowski
arxiv-2406-05113.description: Abstract This paper introduces LlavaGuard, a suite of VLM-based vision safeguards that address the critical need for reliable guardrails in the era of large-scale data and models. To this end, we establish a novel open framework, describing a customizable safety taxonomy, data preprocessing, augmentation, and training setup.

arxiv-2410-12934.title: Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs by Stepwise Correction
arxiv-2410-12934.creator: Zhenyu Wu, Qingkai Zeng, Zhihan Zhang, Zhaoxuan Tan, Chao Shen, Meng Jiang
arxiv-2410-12934.description: Abstract Best-of-N decoding methods instruct large language models (LLMs) to generate multiple solutions, score each using a scoring function, and select the highest scored as the final answer to mathematical reasoning problems. However, this repeated independent process often leads to the same mistakes, making the selected solution still incorrect.

arxiv-2505-20622.title: SeqPO-SiMT: Sequential Policy Optimization for Simultaneous Machine Translation
arxiv-2505-20622.creator: Ting Xu, Zhichao Huang, Jiankai Sun, Shanbo Cheng, Wai Lam
arxiv-2505-20622.description: Abstract We present Sequential Policy Optimization for Simultaneous Machine Translation (SeqPO-SiMT), a new policy optimization framework that defines the simultaneous machine translation (SiMT) task as a sequential decision making problem, incorporating a tailored reward to enhance translation quality while reducing latency.

arxiv-2508-05635.title: Genie Envisioner: A Unified World Foundation Platform for Robotic Manipulation
arxiv-2508-05635.creator: Yue Liao, Pengfei Zhou, Siyuan HuangDonglin YangShengcong Chen, Yuxin Jiang Yue Hu Jingbin Cai Si Liu Jianlan Luo Liliang Chen, Shuicheng Yan Maoqing Yao Guanghui Ren [0.5em] AgiBot Genie TeamNUS LV-LabBUAA[0.5em] https://genie-envisioner.github.io
arxiv-2508-05635.description: Abstract We introduce Genie Envisioner (GE), a unified world foundation platform for robotic manipulation that integrates policy learning, evaluation, and simulation within a single video-generative framework. At its core, GE-Base is a large-scale, instruction-conditioned video diffusion model that captures the spatial, temporal, and semantic dynamics of real-world robotic interactions in a structured latent space.

pmc-11473700.creator: Shivneet K Gill, Seiji N Sugiman-Marangos, Greg L Beilhartz, Elizabeth Mei, Mikko Taipale, Roman A Melnyk
pmc-11473700.description: Targeted intracellular delivery of therapeutic proteins remains a significant unmet challenge in biotechnology. pmc-11503119.creator: Brian C Kavanaugh, Jennifer Elacio, Carrie R Best, Danielle G St Pierre, Matthew F Pescosolido, Qing Ouyang, John Biedermann, Rebecca S Bradley, Judy S Liu, Richard N Jones, Eric M Morrow

pmc-11690114.title: TWO PATHS TO COMMUNITY CARE FOR OLDER ADULTS: KOREA AND SINGAPORE’S LONG-TERM CARE EVOLUTION
pmc-11690114.creator: Jeremy Lim-Soh, Angelique Chan, Aejung Yoo, Dahye Kim, Yugyeong Eo, Jae Woo Choi, Wan Chen Graham, Loong Mun Wong
pmc-11690114.description: Aging populations pose significant challenges to institutional Long-Term Care systems. Community Care services, which provide professional support for functional limitations, chronic diseases, or cognitive impairment to community-dwelling older adults, have emerged as a potentially cost-effective solution that can support aging-in-place. However, differing implementations of Community Care across societies can affect older adults’ health and quality of life.

pmc-12560649.description: BackgroundObstructive sleep apnea is a common condition worldwide, and prostate cancer is the most prevalent cancer among men. However, the link between OSA and prostate cancer remains unclear. This study aims to explore the relationship between OSA and prostate cancer.
